info.title: rdl-doctor
info.description: Scans .rdl/.rdlc report definitions for constructs Majorsilence Reporting's RDL engine doesn't support (Tablix, Gauge/Indicator/Sparkline data regions, unsupported expression functions, and more) -- a compatibility-check tool for migrating from SSRS 2008+ or Crystal Reports.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
doesn't support (a compatibility-check tool for migrating from SSRS 2008+ or Crystal
Reports).

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit non-zero on warnings too, not just errors.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file instead of writing <file>.fixed.rdl.

options.name: --strip-unknown
options.description:
Also remove elements the parser would silently ignore anyway.
Never touches <Tablix> -- that needs a real rewrite, not deletion.
Exit codes (check):
0  no findings (or only informational notes)
1  findings were reported (warnings and/or errors)
2  a file could not be read or parsed as XML at all
A .rpt file (Crystal Reports) can't be checked directly -- convert it to RDL first with
the Majorsilence.Crystal library: https://github.com/majorsilence/majorsilence.crystal
